0001_drama_core.up.sql.correctionReason: This tracked historical migration carries prose comments only and no structured metadata header, so its metadata is recorded here per DATABASE_FRAMEWORK_SPEC.md section 7.2 rather than by rewriting the migration SQL, which stays byte-for-byte unchanged and checksum-covered. The migration creates the drama core tables and indexes, so a reversal would drop them and is lossy; the strategy is recorded as irreversible with a forward-fix rollback. It uses no explicit transaction control and no CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, so transactional is true.
